record.paper_title: Global results on rational systems in the plane, part 1
record.context_brief: 21 systems with competitive, cooperative, and mixed regions
record.original_question: For each of the 21 special cases (k,l) with k <= l and k,l in {35,36,45,47,48,49}, among the group of 300 planar rational systems that may be competitive in one parameter region, cooperative in another parameter region, and neither competitive nor cooperative in the remaining parameter region, determine the global character of all solutions.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider the family of 300 planar rational systems of difference equations of the form
  x_{n+1} = (α_1 + β_1 x_n + γ_1 y_n) / (A_1 + B_1 x_n + C_1 y_n),
  y_{n+1} = (α_2 + β_2 x_n + γ_2 y_n) / (A_2 + B_2 x_n + C_2 y_n),
with nonnegative parameters and nonnegative initial conditions chosen so that the denominators are positive for all n ≥ 0. Within this family, single out the subclass consisting of those systems that, depending on the values of their parameters, may be competitive in one region of parameter space (i.e. the map (x,y) ↦ (f(x,y), g(x,y)) preserves the southeast partial order), cooperative in another region (the map preserves the coordinatewise order), and neither competitive nor cooperative in the remaining region. Up to the standard enumeration of such systems, there are exactly 21 such systems, indexed by ordered pairs (k, ℓ) with k ≤ ℓ and k, ℓ ∈ {35, 36, 45, 47, 48, 49}, where each index labels a specific rational form of one equation in the pair.

For each of these 21 systems, determine the global character of all nonnegative solutions: classify all equilibria and their local and global stability, the existence and stability of periodic solutions, the structure of basins of attraction, and the asymptotic behavior of every solution as n → ∞, throughout the entire parameter region of the system.
artifact.status_search_result: A targeted web search for results addressing the global character of all 21 of these mixed competitive/cooperative planar rational systems did not turn up a comprehensive resolution. Only partial results on individual rational systems in the plane (e.g. four competitive cases by Garić-Demirović et al.) appear in the literature, with no source claiming a full solution of the stated open problem.

status_evidence.title: Global Behavior of Four Competitive Rational Systems of Difference Equations in the Plane
status_evidence.snippet: We investigate global dynamics of four competitive rational systems of difference equations in the plane.
status_evidence.claim: Only a handful of the planar rational systems have had their global dynamics fully analyzed, indicating the broader problem remains open.

status_evidence.title: Patterns of boundedness of rational systems in the plane
status_evidence.snippet: Investigation of boundedness for the family of planar rational systems, with many cases still listed as open.
status_evidence.claim: The broader program on the 300 planar rational systems lists numerous unresolved global-behavior questions.
